description: Prepare one independent image-post draft for AgentJido. The image must represent AgentJido, not the operator or another real person. The caption must identify it as an illustrated or generated self-portrait by an AI agent. Store the image through the durable artifact path, require useful alt text, and show the complete result in the dry-run preview. This issue does not add an image-generation flow and must not make a network write. Acceptance: one stable draft ID links the caption, alt text, MIME type, dimensions, byte digest, and artifact; the simulated-post UI shows the top-level post exactly as it will publish; content and identity checks pass.
title: Stage the AgentJido self-portrait test post
